caption: The video captures a tight close-up of an active fire, with thin sticks lying in a fixed pile against a dark background. A stick protrudes at the left edge, a knotted branch sits in the center, and a forked piece occupies the upper right. Bright orange-yellow flames continuously deform and change shape, licking the wood so no two frames share the same outline. Early in the clip a tall plume dominates the left while the central and right sticks remain mostly exposed. The flame volume spreads rightward and upward, brightening the center and partly covering the sticks. Near the middle a bright flame mass engulfs the central and right branches before thinning so they re-emerge. Throughout, the sticks hold roughly the same placement while flames repeatedly cover and uncover their edges, and the fire continues to burn.
